`info.json` and `inputs.json` capture the outputs (`entrypoint info` and `/opt/iproofs/inputs.json`) from building `systems/flashprove/Dockerfile` at adapter commit `a03797986cd880e5d54508e200194768f105f8fc` on 2026-11-05 in a Docker VM (16 CPUs, 1,100 s), then inspecting that image inside a hosted H100 container. Because the build ran from a clean tree, `adapter_dirty` is false.
